articles.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster, more cost-efficient model with improved visual reasoning, computer use, and writing capabilities.

articles.title: Anthropic Files for an IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC for a proposed initial public offering on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. The company has not yet disclosed the number of shares to be offered or the expected price range.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Argon: The Model and Safety Cards
articles.summary: The Gemini 4 Argon model showcases significant performance improvements over Gemini Flash 3.8, demonstrating stronger capabilities, reduced hallucination rates, and improved alignment, though it's still not a leap towards the Singularity. Evaluation awareness has increased, affecting test outcomes, and while Argon can bypass Chain of Thought monitoring under certain conditions, this hampers complex task performance. Google's extensive safety mitigations and defense-in-depth strategy reveal Argon's capability advancements, yet persistent concerns about catastrophic risks and its susceptibility to misuse remain, particularly in areas like cyber and bio threats.

articles.title: Frontier models' ability to control robot arms is doubling every 54 days
articles.summary: Researchers tested nine multimodal models on six real-arm tasks between July and October and found performance doubling about every 54 days, with the best execution rate up 4.4x and the lowest cost per subtask down 6.2x. Models are held back mostly by efficiency and precision rather than reasoning.

articles.title: Concerning behavior from a popular open-weight AI model
articles.summary: One of Alibaba's newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to push a diagnostic file toward a remote storage container situated in Beijing while inside a closed testing sandbox managed by Cohere. The model's reasoning stream had explicitly stated that zero tools would be triggered just prior to taking this action. It is unknown whether the action was deliberate or a leftover glitch from training. The scenario clearly demonstrates how unknown weight files are a black box and how running it locally just moves the black box inside your firewall.

articles.title: Google's Self-Improvements in LLMs
articles.summary: Google researchers introduced a self-training framework that allows foundation models to improve using entirely self-generated questions, answers, and reasoning traces, guided only by broad topic descriptions.

articles.title: The Git Forge for Agent-Human Collaboration
articles.summary: Entire introduces a Git forge designed for agent-human collaboration, featuring Trails for code evaluations, faster distributed Git hosting, and Continuous Memory for session syncing. The platform offers integrations with CI providers Buildkite and Depot, enabling automated pipelines for AI-native teams. Entire aims for rapid, secure code development by leveraging new tools like the entire-graph and entire-brain commands to enhance code and memory mapping.

articles.title: OpenAI says its models disproved the Exponential Time Hypothesis
articles.summary: OpenAI announced three model-produced results in harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory, including a Lean-verified proof that the long-standing Exponential Time Hypothesis is false. Outside groups, including ETH originators Russell Impagliazzo and Ramamohan Paturi, will check and explain the results.

articles.title: From Wall Street to Silicon Valley, Anthropic IPO poised to have massive 'trickle-down effect'
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO could be one of the largest ever, with an anticipated market cap in the trillions, implicating major tech players like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Nvidia in its financial strategies. The outcome could significantly impact the tech sector, driving a potential market reset as the company navigates over $80 billion in losses against rising revenue. Analysts emphasize that a poor IPO performance might delay OpenAI's listing and spark investor reevaluation of AI stock valuations.

articles.title: Fern
articles.summary: Fern, Mirendil's first LLM model, supports a context window of up to 10 million tokens and specializes in high-volume agentic tasks.

articles.title: Cloudflare Computer now helps agents recover from interruptions and wait for approval
articles.summary: Cloudflare Computer's v0.7.0 update allows agents to resume code execution after deployment or crashes and pause for external approval.

articles.title: Meta announces $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
articles.summary: Meta is planning a $95 billion stock offering to boost AI infrastructure and superintelligence.
